name: FA_ADDITIONS_B
description: FA_ADDITIONS_B contains descriptive information to help identify your assets. When adding an asset, Oracle Fusion Assets inserts a row into this table and into the FA_ASSET_HISTORY table. When changing the asset information stored in this table, Oracle Fusion Assets updates it in this table and also creates a new row in FA_ASSET_HISTORY. When performing a unit retirement, Oracle Fusion Assets reduces the CURRENT_UNITS by the units retired.

columns.name: ASSET_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the asset number.

columns.name: ASSET_NUMBER
columns.description: User-defined asset identification number.

columns.name: ASSET_KEY_CCID
columns.description: Identifier of the asset key flexfield combination.

columns.name: CURRENT_UNITS
columns.description: Current number of units for an asset.

columns.name: ASSET_TYPE
columns.description: Type of the asset allowed in the Oracle Fusion Assets. The asset types allowed are Capitalized, Construction-in-Process, Expensed, and Group.

columns.name: TAG_NUMBER
columns.description: Unique user-defined tracking number for an asset.

columns.name: ASSET_CATEGORY_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the asset category.

columns.name: PARENT_ASSET_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the parent asset for the child or component asset.

columns.name: MANUFACTURER_NAME
columns.description: Name of the manufacturer of the asset.

columns.name: SERIAL_NUMBER
columns.description: Serial number assigned to the asset.

columns.name: MODEL_NUMBER
columns.description: Model number assigned to the asset.

columns.name: PROPERTY_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Option indicating whether the asset is considered personal, real, or residential property.

columns.name: PROPERTY_1245_1250_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether the asset belongs to the 1245 property class or 1250 property class.

columns.name: IN_USE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicator used to determine whether the asset is in use.

columns.name: OWNED_LEASED
columns.description: Indicates whether asset is owned or leased.

columns.name: NEW_USED
columns.description: Option indicating whether asset is new or used.

columns.name: INVENTORIAL
columns.description: Indicates whether the asset should be included in physical inventory.

columns.name: COMMITMENT
columns.description: Financial liability or commitment assigned to the asset.

columns.name: INVESTMENT_LAW
columns.description: Benefit incentives applied to the asset.

columns.name: DISTRIBUTION_SOURCE_BOOK
columns.description: Identifier of the asset book which contains the asset distribution information.

columns.name: LEASE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the capital or operating lease.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
